tha-ap112:1.1: Reṇupūjaka.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ sataraṃsīva bhānumaṃ / obhāsentaṃ disā sabbā uḷurājaṃ va pūrītaṃ // //
tha-ap112:2.1: Purakkh*ataṃ sāvakehi sāgareneva medinī / nāgaṃ pa*ggayha reṇūhi Vipassissābhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap112:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ reṇum abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap112:4.1: Paṇṇatālīs' ito *kappe Reṇu-nām' āsi khattiyo / sattaratana*sampanno cakkavattī mahābalo. // //
tha-ap112:5.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap112:6.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Reṇupūjakothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
